subject: Harbor BioSystems — AP onboarding & PO routing / vendor registration
messages:
From: Kevin Shaw <kevin.shaw@harborbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@harborbio.com
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration — AP packet and PO template

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. We're ready to bring Redwood into Harbor's vendor registry so we can route POs and settle invoices. Please send the AP packet and the format you need us to include on POs (any prefix, required fields, VAT handling).

A few specifics from our side that will affect routing:
- Harbor requires a vendor form (attached) completed and signed.
- We use PO numbers with a 4-digit project prefix (e.g., HB-1234-XXXXX); please confirm how you prefer PO linking on invoices.
- For EU invoices, VAT reverse-charge will apply on certain purchases — we need your VAT number and confirmation whether you issue VAT-inclusive or VAT-exempt invoices.

I've attached Harbor_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf for completion. If you can return the completed form and a sample invoice PDF, our AP onboarding team will create a vendor ID and give you the vendor token for electronic submission.

Regards,
Kevin Shaw
Director, Procurement Operations
Harbor BioSystems
[Attachment: Harbor_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kevin Shaw <kevin.shaw@harborbio.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com, accounts-payable@harborbio.com
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration — AP packet and PO template

Hi Kevin — thanks, we can turn this around quickly. Quick answers up front:
- We will complete and sign the Harbor form and return by end of day Monday.
- Redwood invoices should include the full PO string Harbor uses (HB-1234-XXXXX) in the "PO Number" field and include your vendor ID once provided. We can map multiple PO prefixes if needed.
- VAT: Redwood issues VAT-exclusive invoices by default and includes our VAT ID when applicable. Our EU tax team confirms we can support reverse-charge notation on the invoice line if you supply the EU VAT reverse-charge indicator per line item.

Next steps we propose:
1) We complete the attached Harbor form and return it signed.
2) We send a sample invoice (PDF + XML stub) showing PO mapping and the reverse-charge field.
3) Once Harbor creates the vendor record, please share the vendor token and any API submission endpoints or SFTP credentials for electronic invoice ingestion.

I've looped Marissa (Account Lead) and Naomi (Finance) for implementation.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Success — North America
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0172

[Attachment: Redwood_Sample_Invoice_Harbor.pdf (pdf)]

From: AP Team <accounts-payable@harborbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood vendor registration — AP packet and PO template

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks — received the sample invoice. A couple of notes from our vendor onboarding checklist (attached as Excel):
- Please return the completed Harbor_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf with a wet or electronic signature.
- We will issue a Harbor Vendor ID within 2 business days after receiving the signed form and a W9 (US) or W-8/W-9 equivalent.
- For invoice ingestion: we accept PDF email submissions to our ingestion mailbox (invoices@harborbio.com) and EDI/Peppol for larger partners; we will set up SFTP for automated drops if you prefer.
- Mandatory invoice fields: Invoice Date, Invoice Number, Invoice Amount (USD/EUR), PO Number (full string), Line-level description, Tax/VAT amount column (can be 0). If reverse-charge is used, include the notation: "Reverse charge — article 194(1)" in the tax remarks column.
- Our PO matching engine requires the PO Number in a dedicated header field; embedded references in the body are not sufficient.

Attachments: Harbor_PO_Requirements.xlsx (attached) covers our mapping and sample XML. Please confirm if Redwood can emit an invoice XML feed with a dedicated PO element and a VAT flags field.

Regards,
Harbor AP Team
[Attachment: Harbor_PO_Requirements.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com
To: accounts-payable@harborbio.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration — AP packet and PO template

Hi Harbor team — appreciate the checklist. Internal notes and commitments: 
- Naomi will attach the company W9 and signed onboarding form to this thread before EOD Tuesday and will include a sample XML that contains: <invoice><po_number>HB-1234-00001</po_number><vat_flag>RC</vat_flag> etc. (we'll anonymize the sample).
- Finance asks: please confirm the vendor token format (we've seen both numeric IDs and GUID-style tokens) so our AP automation can map correctly.
- For SFTP vs email ingestion: we prefer SFTP for recurring invoices; please send the contact for SFTP provisioning.

Action items for Harbor: provide vendor ID / token, confirm SFTP contact, and confirm whether Harbor will apply early-pay discounts to PO-level payment terms (we have a wholesale discount addendum to discuss).

Thanks — Vivek/Marissa will follow up once forms and sample files are uploaded.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
